assertions.assertion: The procedure was performed to evaluate symptomatic dizziness and giddiness
The patient has atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The indication note states the procedure is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes that may be contributing to these symptomatic episodes
The associated symptom code is R42
Precertification was not obtained prior to service
The denial was under code CO-197
The documented diagnosis, symptoms, and stated clinical purpose support medical necessity for this diagnostic procedure
